messages:
sara-support: Customer Acme Solar (acct 78910) — they say VIES validates VAT ID NL123456789B01 but invoice 2026-INV-4421 was issued with 21% VAT. They attached `resale_cert.png` in the portal and provided PO PO-7733. Finance refuses payment until invoice reflects reverse charge. Can billing/ops advise? https://files.redwood/support/78910/2026-INV-4421/resale_cert.png

ingrid-billing: Thanks — can you paste the exact invoice id & the uploaded filename? I can check audit logs and whether an exemption flag was set at issuance.

sara-support: Invoice ID is 2026-INV-4421, attachment name is `resale_cert.png`. Customer also pasted VIES check link: https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/vatResponse.html?memberStateCode=NL&number=123456789B01 — they say it returned "valid" on 2026-03-10.

max-engineer: Pinging billing infra — I pulled the VAT-validation service log. The external VIES call returned valid, we normalized the ID to `NL123456789B01`. Sample response we get from validator (sanitized):
```
{
  "vat_id": "NL123456789B01",
  "valid": true,
  "source": "VIES",
  "checked_at": "2026-03-10T09:12:34Z"
}
```
However the invoice issuance pipeline also checks uploaded evidence OCR text against the VAT ID; OCR returned `NL123456789` (suffix lost) so automatic match failed and `no_exemption` path was taken. Looks like OCR strips the trailing letter group on some PNG scans.

sara-support: Customer insists the PDF/PDF-scan contains the full ID. They uploaded PNG — maybe compression/scan caused OCR error.

dylan-legal: From legal side: we can apply reverse charge retroactively if customer supplies a certificate that clearly shows the VAT ID and company name that matches billing details on file (Acme Solar BV). Need one of: a signed resale certificate, a VAT registration extract, or an official VIES printout saved as PDF. PNG scans are OK but prefer PDF. Also we require the name on the cert to match the billing name exactly or a note linking the trading name.

ingrid-billing: Can we do a manual override while we await a new upload? Customer has PO and is blocked. Proposed steps: 1) Ask customer to re-upload PDF (preferably A4, 300dpi). 2) If they cannot, billing can create a manual credit + reissue invoice without VAT after legal confirms. 3) Log the evidence file in the invoice notes.

acme-finance: (customer) We can re-upload as PDF today. We used an exported PNG from our procurement portal. Please expedite — payment hold is causing delay on our side.

max-engineer: If billing wants to avoid waiting, there is a CLI admin override we can use: `billing override-exemption --acct 78910 --invoice 2026-INV-4421 --reason "VIES valid; customer provided image; OCR false negative" --actor ingrid-billing`. It will mark the invoice as reverse-charge and create a credit+reissue flow. I can walk through the steps. Note: this bypasses the OCR evidence check so legal confirmed we should only use it with explicit customer confirmation.

dylan-legal: OK to proceed with manual override provided customer re-uploads within 72h and we attach a note that legal approved provisional reverse charge pending final evidence.

ingrid-billing: I'll do the override once customer confirms re-upload. For traceability, please include the portal upload URL and the original PNG in the invoice note. Also set follow-up task to attach final PDF to the invoice.

sara-support: Customer uploaded a PDF version: https://files.redwood/support/78910/2026-INV-4421/resale_cert.pdf — they confirmed the name is "Acme Solar BV" and VAT ID exactly `NL123456789B01`.

ingrid-billing: Verified PDF — OCR confirmed full VAT string and name match. Creating credit note + reissue.

billing-bot: Credit note CN-2026-0015 created for invoice 2026-INV-4421, amount 21% VAT reversed. New invoice 2026-INV-4421-R issued without VAT. Linked PO: PO-7733. Notes: manual override flagged (ingrid-billing), legal provisional clearance logged.

acme-finance: Thanks — we received the reissued invoice and scheduled payment. Appreciate quick help :thumbsup:

max-engineer: Filing a short post-action note on the OCR model: flagged PNGs that contain multi-segment VAT suffixes (letters/numbers like B01) are a common failure. I'll open a ticket to improve parser tolerances to reduce manual work.

sara-support: Closing loop — customer confirmed payment scheduled. Leaving follow-up to billing to ensure final evidence is attached and legal note is archived.
